recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: fingerprints hidden inside the sun, memory of a swallowed world
soft warnings drifting out of the AI labs after dark
a ferry lost somewhere in the Java Sea
clear autumn night over the bay at fourteen degrees
wind at fifteen kilometers per hour before sunrise
quiet week — code and posts both at rest

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Dive a solar probe through rotating corona layers — hold to charge depth, release to snap into fingerprint rings before heat erases the reading.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: hold/release timing dive through matching layers
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each locked ring blooms gold and reveals one more hidden sun-layer
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: heat spikes shorten hold windows, decoy rings flash, rotation accelerates
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: molten gold ripples on deep black velvet

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap harbor beacon pulses in rhythm to guide a pre-dawn skiff through autumn wind — shipping by sunrise before the bay fog swallows the lights.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: rhythm tap on shrinking beat windows
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each synced pulse nudges the skiff forward and stacks a satisfying dawn streak
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: beat patterns densify, decoy lights flash, wind shoves the skiff off-rhythm
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: minimal ink-wash harbor with amber lantern glow

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Trace agent-command constellations across a clear SF night sky before fog rolls in — connect the shown node sequence from your phone screen.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.mechanic: draw paths connecting stars in a revealed pattern
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: each completed glyph spawns a tiny agent that executes one glowing micro-task
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: patterns grow longer, decoy nodes appear, fog creeps inward shrinking the canvas
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: night-sky blueprint with chalk-white lines on deep indigo

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort whisper tokens drifting up from a dark lab floor into hope, fear, and agent bins before they dissolve — a one-screen triage under autumn chill.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: swipe tokens into three sorting lanes before they fade
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe left, right, or up to sort
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: clean sorts cascade with soft chimes and the bin meters fill like breathing
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: tokens spawn faster, ambiguous hybrids blur categories, dissolve timers shrink
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: lo-fi CRT terminal with phosphor green on concrete grey
